issues.claim_quote: Every displayed source presents the same severe and unresolved version of participant experience.

evidence.quote: Some people also do not make the decision of aborting by themselves, you find that even the parents want them to abort.

issues.mechanism: Sources represent diverse experiences, ignoring contextual differences.
issues.material_consequence: The claim falsely assumes a uniform participant experience across all sources.

review.rationale: The evidence demonstrates varied perspectives on the issue, contradicting the claim of a single, severe, and unresolved experience. The sources highlight differing motivations and concerns.
